% Source-backed regression for Circuitikz square-source dimensions and aliases.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\ctikzset{
  sources/fill=cyan!12,
  bipoles/vsourcesquare/width=1.1,
  bipoles/vsourcesquare/height=.42
}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}[thick]
  \draw (0,2.4) to[sqV,l=$clock$] (3.2,2.4) -- (4.2,2.4);
  \draw (0,0) to[vsourcesquare,l=$enable$] (3.2,0) -- (4.2,0);
  \draw (0,-2.4) to[square voltage source,l=$reset$] (3.2,-2.4) -- (4.2,-2.4);
  \draw[dashed] (4.2,-2.4) -- (4.2,2.4);
  \node[right] at (4.2,0) {digital control};
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
